entries.reason: a live audio graph is drawn by an assistive technology, and this release runs none: the whole Accessibility surface it holds is the AXS* preference library, measured, and no publisher of a graph is in it. The class is carried, its three class methods keep it and say once each that nothing draws the graph, and the class holds no state - the host own instance has no ivar at all, measured with class_copyIvarList
entries.effect: the class is there and NSClassFromString finds it, the method does nothing, and it writes exactly one line to the log however many times it is called - which is what the case holds it to: it calls each member of the graph several times and counts the port's log lines against the counts it printed, and a port that wrote a line per call fails the run
